entry.name: gen_dsp_rate
entry.digest: Time-scale the output of a phasor
entry.description: The rate operator time-scales an input phase (such as from a phasor) by a multiplier. Multipliers less than 1 create several ramps per phase cycle.

attributes.name: sync
attributes.digest: determine how the rate stays in sync with the input phasor
attributes.description: If sync is set to lock, the output phase will be recalculated whenever the input multiplier changes to maintain a smooth ramp. If the sync is set to cycle, this recalculation is deferred until the next cycle of the input phasor.
